name: IRM-10-5
title: IRM-10: 10 W encapsulated PCB-mount AC-DC module, 85 to 305 Vac in, one isolated output
summary: A potted, board-mounted AC-DC supply of about 10 W in a 45.7 × 25.4 × 21.5 mm case with four through-hole pins. It accepts 85 to 305 Vac (47 to 440 Hz) or 120 to 430 Vdc and gives one isolated output of 3.3, 5, 12, 15 or 24 V depending on the model; the IRM-10-5 gives 5 V at up to 2 A. Its EMI filter is inside, it is a Class II design with no earth pin, it draws under 0.1 W unloaded, and it protects itself against short circuit, overload and output overvoltage. It runs from -30 to +85 °C ambient with load derating above 50 °C and below 100 Vac.

notes: The name has three fields: IRM is the series, 10 the rated wattage, and the last field the output voltage (3.3, 5, 12, 15 or 24 V).

operation.text: The module sits in a 94V-0 flame-retardant plastic case potted with silicone. The potting helps heat dissipation, withstands vibration up to 5 G and gives basic resistance to dust and moisture. Cooling is by free-air convection.

The block diagram runs from the input through an EMI filter, a rectifier and bulk filter, a PWM-controlled switching stage and a transformer, to an output rectifier and filter feeding +V and -V. A detection circuit on the output returns its signal across the isolation through an optocoupler to the PWM controller. The switching frequency is 65 kHz.

Overload protection trips between 115 % and 190 % of rated output power. The module then runs in hiccup mode and recovers by itself once the fault is cleared. The module is also protected against short circuit.
If the output rises into the model's trip range (5.75 to 6.75 V for the IRM-10-5), the module turns its output off and a zener diode clamps it.

At full load the output appears within 600 ms of power-on and rises in 30 ms; the set-up time can grow when the supply is cycled. The output holds for 30 ms after the input drops at 230 Vac, 8 ms at 115 Vac, at full load. A cold start draws an inrush of 20 A at 115 Vac or 40 A at 230 Vac.
Full load is allowed from -30 °C to 50 °C ambient. Above 50 °C the allowed load falls: 75 % at 60 °C, 50 % at 70 °C, 23 % at 80 °C and 10 % at 85 °C. These figures are for horizontal mounting.
Full load is allowed from 100 Vac to 305 Vac (60 Hz). Below 100 Vac the allowed load falls to 80 % at 85 Vac.

The case has no earth pin and the design is Class II. Input and output are isolated for 4.2 kVac. The internal filter brings conducted and radiated emissions within EN55032 Class B with nothing added outside.
